status_summary: Two House bills to lift the restrictions were introduced in the 119th Congress: H.R. 3022 on 2025-04-24 and H.R. 4002 on 2025-06-12, each referred to the Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means Committees. The GovInfo bill status records show no committee action after referral for either bill, no enactment was found, and Public Law 119-21 of 2025-07-04 lists no physician-owned hospital provision in its Health subtitle table of contents.

timeline.event: H.R. 3022, the Restoring Rights of Physicians to Own Hospitals Act, was introduced and referred to Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means; it would strike the Social Security Act section 1877(i) limits and related rural and hospital exception conditions.

H.R. 4002, the Patient Access to Higher Quality Health Care Act of 2025, was introduced; it would repeal the ACA changes (sections 6001 and 10601 of Public Law 111-148 and section 1106 of Public Law 111-152) to the whole hospital exception.

title: Remove ACA restrictions on physician-owned and specialty hospitals in Medicare
uncertainties: Mandate text on page 464 was checked. The two bills were read on the GovInfo host. H.R. 4002 repeals sections 6001 and 10601 of Public Law 111-148 and section 1106 of Public Law 111-152 without naming the statutory subsection they changed; its title refers to the Medicare hospital exception to the physician referral prohibition, and the link to physician-owned hospitals also rests on the support letter on the aans.org host. Enactment status was judged from the Public Law 119-21 table of contents (the page text was truncated, so the body was not read) and from one web search; no search of the 2026 spending law text was possible because its health division was cut off in the fetched page.
